hero.title: About us
hero.lead: A family farming project in the Aramaio valley, devoted to natural organic cider.

story.title: From Vitoria to Aramaio, since 1997.
story.p1: Iturrieta is a family farming and livestock project. In 1997 we moved from Vitoria to this beautiful farmhouse in Aramaio and turned the cattle and sheep stables into a cider house.
story.p2: It opened on 25 July 1998, St. James's Day. We planted 600 apple trees at first and today tend around 1,400, mixing Basque and Asturian varieties.
story.p3: After more than 20 years in the cider world, we now make certified natural organic cider.

valley.title: The Aramaio valley.
valley.p1: The Aramaio valley —also called "Suiza Txiki" (little Switzerland)— lies in northern Álava, next to Bizkaia and Gipuzkoa (Debagoiena), and is part of the Gorbeialdea cuadrilla.
valley.p2: Surrounded by mountains such as Orixol, Anboto and Udalaitz to the north, and Murugain, Kurtzebarri, Aloña and Aizkorri to the east. At 485 m, with an Atlantic climate and mild temperatures.

harvest.title: How the 2026 harvest is going.
harvest.p1: The trees have borne little fruit this year: the apple tree is biennial and it was its year to rest. On top of that, two storms over Aramaio brought a lot of apples down, so we expect a smaller harvest than last year.
harvest.p2: We start picking around 10 September, well ahead of the usual date because of the heat. Even so, we expect a good cider.

production.eyebrow: Zer ekoizten dugu · What we produce
production.title: Cider and juice, natural and organic
production.lead: Our cider and apple juice are fully natural and organic, made with apples from our own orchards.

row1.title: Healthy apple trees
row1.body: Sunny, well-ventilated orchards with diverse varieties, cared for constantly under the advice of specialist technicians.

row2.title: Pruning and care
row2.body: Pruning in winter and summer (November to March and August), blossoming around April and harvest from October to mid-November.

row3.title: Our own products
row3.body: Organic cider and juice, as well as apple vinegar and apple cava, made at the farmhouse.
